name: glb-designer-stage8b
description: Asset Studio Iteration 4 Stage 8b — taper deformer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Seeds a tapered box PEDESTAL (taper 0.4), a tapered + bevelled PLANTER (taper 0.3 + corner radius), and a tapered EXTRUDE (taper 0.5 along the depth/Z axis), then screenshots the assembly (clean sloped sides, no shading artifacts on the recomputed normals). Finally does a save/restore round-trip through the designer's spec seam and asserts the taper fields survive (envelope v12), re-rendering the identical pose.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: seed-taper-showcase
steps.comment: Pedestal: plain box tapered 0.4 (top narrows). Planter: box tapered 0.3 + bevel 0.06 (rounded tapered box). Extrude: hexagon outline tapered 0.5 along its Z depth axis (front cross-section shrinks).
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); s.partGroups = []; s.combineGroups = []; s.decals = []; s.parts = [ { id:'pedestal', kind:'box', name:'Tapered pedestal', position:[-0.55,0.3,0], size:[0.32,0.6,0.32], color:'#b08d57', taper:0.4 }, { id:'planter', kind:'box', name:'Tapered planter', position:[0,0.19,0], size:[0.4,0.38,0.4], color:'#7d8a74', taper:0.3, bevel:0.06 }, { id:'ext', kind:'extrude', name:'Tapered extrude', position:[0.6,0.18,0], size:[0.34,0.36,0.5], color:'#9c6b4f', taper:0.5, bevel:0.02, outline:[[-0.4,-0.5],[0.4,-0.5],[0.5,0.0],[0.2,0.5],[-0.2,0.5],[-0.5,0.0]] } ]; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: settle-fit
steps.comment: Let drei <Bounds> finish easing its auto-fit so the taper shot uses the settled pose.

steps.name: assert-taper-applied
steps.comment: The seeded spec carries the three taper factors, and the built three.js scene has real meshes (taper is intrinsic geometry, so it builds without a gizmo change).
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const t = s.parts.map(p => p.taper); if (JSON.stringify(t) !== JSON.stringify([0.4,0.3,0.5])) throw new Error('taper factors not seeded, got '+JSON.stringify(t)); let meshes=0; window.__glbDesignerThree.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.getAttribute('position')) meshes++; }); if (meshes < 3) throw new Error('expected >=3 meshes, got '+meshes); console.log('8B_SEED taper='+JSON.stringify(t)+' meshes='+meshes); })()

steps.name: save-restore-roundtrip
steps.comment: Round-trip the spec through the designer's setSpec/getSpec seam (the same AssetEditSpec the v12 envelope serialises); assert every taper survives.
steps.eval: (function(){ const before = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(before)); window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(clone); const after = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const t = after.parts.map(p => p.taper); if (JSON.stringify(t) !== JSON.stringify([0.4,0.3,0.5])) throw new Error('taper lost on round-trip, got '+JSON.stringify(t)); console.log('8B_ROUNDTRIP taper='+JSON.stringify(t)); })()
